card.name: Balancing effect against lowest dose
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "with", "but", "to" or "be" in dose-adjustment instructions, right where the text goes on to say lowest effective dose or minimal side effects.

modes.label: Linking word before minimal-effect phrase
modes.description: "with" or "but" after a goal like control or response, leading into "lowest effective dose" or "minimum of adverse effects".
modes.example: Dosage should be individualized to obtain an adequate response<< with>> the lowest effective dose.

modes.label: Dose reduced or adjusted to a level
modes.description: "to", "be" or "possible" in phrases about reducing or adjusting the dose to the smallest or individual level.
modes.example: When a satisfactory response is obtained, dosage should be reduced<< to>> the smallest amount needed to maintain the rem
